attack_1_printed_damage.description: Numeric damage printed beside the name of attack 1, counting attacks from top to bottom. Count every attack, including GX attacks and attacks without printed damage; do not count Abilities or skip an attack because its text is unreadable. Extract only the number beside the attack name, ignoring a trailing + or multiplication symbol. Do not use numbers from energy costs or rules prose, calculate conditional damage, or reconstruct missing text. Return null if this attack is absent or its printed damage number is absent or unreadable.
